decisions.why: Duolith and Masterpuls shockwave therapy systems for musculoskeletal use are capital equipment
Modulith SLX-F2 and SLK are extracorporeal lithotripter systems for kidney stones
on Lou's decision 25/08/2026; named products (Duolith and Masterpuls vet shockwave systems) are veterinary therapy equipment

sole example, Neurolith (TPS), is Storz Medical's non-invasive extracorporeal shockwave neuromodulation device — new type added under neuro 26/08/2026 on Lou's decision, distinct from the existing implantable-device types (scs/dbs/sns/pns)

sole example, Modulith SLC, is Storz Medical's extracorporeal shockwave system (also used for cardiac shockwave therapy) — same underlying shockwave technology as the Neurology division, mapped to the same new type per Lou's decision to bundle neuromodulation/shockwave devices together
